artifact: Profile header, article list, and shared design-system adoption
decision_context: Follow an author, access profile actions, scan articles, and migrate the shared UI safely.

evidence.notes: The original view gives Follow and Message equal visual weight, hides Share and Bookmark in an overflow menu, and wraps every article in a bordered card.
The action API distinguishes follow, message, share, and bookmark, but does not declare priority or disclosure policy.
No versioned legacy-to-target mapping or deprecation gate was supplied.

affordance_mappings.visual_treatment: Blue filled rounded containers match the primary action treatment.
affordance_mappings.actual_behavior: Static metadata icons with no action
affordance_mappings.evidence: The static icons and the primary action share the same button-like surface treatment.

affordance_mappings.visual_treatment: The selected destination uses a filled icon plus a persistent text label.
affordance_mappings.actual_behavior: Navigates to the destination and exposes the current state.
affordance_mappings.evidence: Selection is communicated by shape and label rather than colour alone.

action_groups.user_decision: Choose whether to follow the author or start a message.
action_groups.reading_and_focus_order: Back, profile identity, Follow, Message, Share, Bookmark.
action_groups.evidence: Both actions use the same filled treatment, and no product requirement establishes equal priority.

action_groups.user_decision: Open one article from the profile.
action_groups.reading_and_focus_order: Article title precedes metadata and the record link follows source order.
action_groups.evidence: Each repeated record has one clear navigation action.

action_visibility.available_space_evidence: The header has room for two icon actions beside the back control.
action_visibility.evidence: Share is available only after opening the overflow menu despite visible free space.

action_visibility.disclosure_reason: The destructive action should not compete with frequent profile actions and requires confirmation.
action_visibility.available_space_evidence: Persistent placement is not needed for the supported task.
action_visibility.evidence: The declared information architecture provides a stable settings path and confirmation step.

grouping_decisions.relationship: Title, metadata, author, and image belong to one repeated article record.
grouping_decisions.evidence: Repeated alignment, spacing, and record schema preserve grouping after the borders are removed.

system_lifecycle.system_scope: Shared colour, typography, action, navigation, and article-record components.
system_lifecycle.contribution_process: Design and implementation changes require a shared review from the design-system owner and one consuming product team.
system_lifecycle.decision_process: Material changes record the problem, evidence, owner decision, affected consumers, and review trigger.
system_lifecycle.versioning_and_changelog: Component releases use semantic versions and a consumer-facing changelog.
system_lifecycle.roadmap: Prioritize semantic colour and typography, then migrate touched components during feature work.
system_lifecycle.adoption_strategy: Adopt incrementally and record component adoption status by product surface.
system_lifecycle.coexistence_rules: Legacy and target components may coexist only when each usage is labeled and has an owner.
system_lifecycle.evidence: The supplied plan has no complete legacy mapping or measurable removal gate.

findings.problem: Static icons use the same button-like treatment as an operable primary action.
findings.impact: People may attempt to operate non-interactive content or miss the actual action model.
findings.smallest_change: Remove the action surface treatment from static icons or make the intended interaction explicit.
findings.verification: Compare pointer, keyboard, and touch behaviour with the declared affordance map.

findings.problem: Follow and Message compete as equal primary actions without an equal-priority requirement.
findings.impact: The next step is less clear at the main profile decision point.
findings.smallest_change: Declare one primary action for this context or document why the actions have equal priority.
findings.verification: Run the glance-hierarchy and primary-task tests on the revised action group.

findings.problem: The adoption plan has no complete legacy mapping or deprecation gate.
findings.impact: Old and new components can coexist indefinitely without measurable convergence.
findings.smallest_change: Record current-to-target mappings, adoption status, removal criteria, owners, and review dates.
findings.verification: Audit one release against the mapping and confirm obsolete usages can be enumerated.

unknowns: Production analytics do not establish how often Share and Bookmark are used.
The design-system migration inventory was not supplied.
